messages:
Mariam Okoye: Hi everyone — quick org update: effective next Monday (2026-04-06) we're formalizing a split of Runtime + Capacity into two cross-functional squads: "Serving" (latency/throughput, model routing, KV caching) and "Control Plane" (deployments, rollouts, autoscaling, billing). The goal is clearer ownership for per-token performance vs platform orchestration, and faster iteration on SLOs. Full doc: https://go.redwood.company/org/serving-controlplane (permissions: Redwood Staff).

Mariam Okoye: Leadership changes: Diego Morales will move to Director, Serving; he'll own runtime, serving runtime optimizations, and model-variant routing. We're also hiring two managers to support the transition: Aisha Patel (incoming Senior Eng Manager, Serving) and Tom Nguyen (incoming Capacity/Autoscale Manager). Aisha and Tom start in ~2 weeks; People Ops is finalizing relocation/offer details.

Mariam Okoye: Interim coverage: Platform Eng leads will span the two squads for the next 3 weeks. Diego and I will run weekly syncs and a public office hour on Thursday 11am PT to walk through the rollout plan and migration checklist. Please add any migration concerns to the doc.

Lizzy Mendoza: congrats all :tada: — can you add the updated oncall matrix to the doc? need to update pager rotations.

Priya Natarajan: Quick Q — will canary/fallback routing still be owned by Serving? wondering how SRE/oncall triage will change for cross-slab incidents.

Diego Morales: Short answer: yes, serving will own canary + real-time routing. Control Plane will own deployment choreography, config, and quotas. We'll publish a clear runbook this week. excited to get started.

Aisha Patel: thanks everyone — thrilled to join. I'll post a 1:1 sign-up for folks who want to sync on existing service interfaces and perf pain points.

Tom Nguyen: looking forward to working with the capacity folks. I'll shadow current autoscaler runbooks this week and share a checklist for handoffs.

People Ops: Offer and onboarding docs for Aisha and Tom are live. New hire checklist: ID, laptop, GitHub + infra access, payroll. Link: https://go.redwood.company/onboarding/aisha-tom

devex-bot: Reminder: update team repos + CODEOWNERS by Fri 18:00 PT to reflect squad ownership. See #eng-runtime for PR flow.

Mariam Okoye: Thanks all — if you have questions, drop them in this thread or join the office hours. We'll post the final org chart + ownership matrix after the Thursday sync.
